scope: every sense authored in the first mixed verb/noun tick (shards 017v and 017n), drawn complete rather than sampled
authoring: parallel author agents on Opus 5, family-author.md read verbatim from disk as a registered agent definition, prompts identical across all 8 families
comparability: FIRST CENSUS OUTSIDE ADJECTIVES. Both instruments are unchanged from censuses 007-010, so the rate is comparable on the instrument; the population is not - it is verbs and nouns, drawn from the book worklist rather than the Zipf worklist. Read a difference from ~2% as a fact about the new part of speech or the new selector, not about the ruler.
pre_read_checks: tone_lint clean on all rules, 0 of 99 notes flagged; sensitive_screen flagged happiness (gaiety/merriment on a 'a gay feeling' gloss) and it was cleared by hand as WordNet's archaic sense of cheerful, not an identity term

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A felt response to something, where *esteem* is a verdict on it.

entries.definition: great coolness and composure under strain
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise with a flourish: the coolness under strain reads as polished and assured, not merely maintained.

entries.definition: great coolness and composure under strain
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the weight on self-certainty as the root of the coolness, plainer and less stylish than *aplomb*.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Puts the faith down like a deposit, everything in one place and nothing held back.

entries.definition: happiness felt in a secure relationship
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Pins the happiness to a secure relationship rather than leaving it a free-floating mood as *gladness* does.
examples: with his classmates he felt a sense of belonging

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Frames the faith as a stake laid down, conceding in the same breath that it could be lost, where *rely* concedes nothing of the kind.
examples: You can bet on that!

entries.definition: a feeling of spontaneous good spirits
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same spontaneous good spirits with a lighter, more carefree edge than *cheerfulness*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: French, and it bundles good humor in with the happiness where *happiness* names the feeling alone.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Slang with a shrug in it, making the killing offhand and almost comic in a way *slay* never allows.

entries.definition: murder without leaving a trace on the body
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the killing by its method, leaving no mark on the body, and is chilling precisely because it is that specific where *murder* is general.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Makes the confidence the outcome of working something out, so it sounds arrived at rather than felt.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Bare and short — names the steady state itself rather than the effort of keeping it, which is what *composure* implies.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The flat quality-noun, describing the steadiness rather than admiring it as *equanimity* does.

entries.definition: a feeling of spontaneous good spirits
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Good spirits that rise unbidden, a steady sunniness rather than the crest of *rejoicing*.
examples: his cheerfulness made everyone feel better

entries.definition: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Tilts the same skill toward wariness - looking all round a situation for the embarrassment or distress in it.

entries.definition: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Idiomatic and flat: shut to understanding with none of the allure *mystery* can carry, and no expectation of opening.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving at the workaday end - soundness in practical matters, the kind expected of anyone rather than marvelled at.
examples: Common sense is not so common

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most morally weighted here - sharing the suffering treated as a virtue exercised, and stiff enough as a verb to sound elevated.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain name for holding steady when pressure is on, with none of the flourish *aplomb* brings to the same feat.
examples: he accepted their problems with composure and she with equanimity

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and ceremonious - the sharing is performed toward the sufferer rather than merely felt.

entries.definition: happiness with one's situation in life
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The quietest member, happiness settled on one's situation in life instead of flaring at anything in particular.

entries.definition: great coolness and composure under strain
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and offhand — makes great steadiness under strain sound like something a person simply has, and can lose, where *sang-froid* makes it formal.
examples: keep your cool

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Treats the confidence as already entered in the tally, so the thing believed in is settled rather than merely hoped for.
examples: you can count on me to help you any time

entries.definition: have trust in; trust in the truth or veracity of
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Aims the trust at whether a thing is true rather than whether it will hold, granting belief where *lean* grants weight.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The confidence has need underneath it, with nothing else holding the one who depends upright.
examples: Depend on your family in times of crisis

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Spells out both the trust and the assurance behind it, firmer and more deliberate than the bare *depend*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The weightier, more formal cast of *depend on*, claiming exactly the same confident placing of trust.

entries.definition: state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavorable options
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the weight on the shape of the trap - two branches, neither of them good - so the uncertainty has a hard structure to it.

entries.definition: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise pitched at fineness - the stress falls on discriminating what a coarser mind would run together.

entries.definition: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same avoidance named off the adjective, drier and more clinical than *discretion*.

entries.definition: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for a tactful kind of knowing - steering clear of what would embarrass or distress before it arises.
examples: the servants showed great tact and discretion

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Brisk and efficient, filing the killing under business concluded rather than under wrongdoing.

entries.definition: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal, and frames the inexplicable thing as a posed puzzle rather than the open blankness of *mystery*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Elevated and admiring — steadiness under stress treated as an evenness of temper worth crediting, well above workaday *calmness*.
examples: he accepted their problems with composure and she with equanimity

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and cool: high regard delivered as an assessment rather than a felt rush.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Lends a planned murder the cold air of sentence carried out, borrowing an authority the act does not have.

entries.definition: good discernment (either visually or as if visually)
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Compact and admiring, with 'good' built into the word, and it covers seeing with the eyes or the figurative equivalent alike.
examples: she has an eye for fresh talent
he has an artist's eye

entries.definition: regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The member in which awe keeps its edge of dread — respect owed to something too exalted to face lightly.
examples: Fear God as your father

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warm and plain-spoken, the sharing conveyed with none of the formality of *condole with*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Brightness and lightness in the feeling, weightless where *rejoicing* is full and heavy.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same joy and pleasure as *gladness*, given a fuller and more formal shape.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Joy and pleasure actively felt rather than merely possessed, warmer than *contentment* and quieter than *merriment*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Literary in cast, dressing the joy and pleasure of *gladness* in ornament the plainer form does without.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The bare commendation, with 'good' carrying the whole judgement and no claim past soundness.
examples: fortunately she had the good sense to run away

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain full-weight word for grief felt as grief, neither approving nor blaming the one who feels it.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and hearty - the same practical soundness spoken of as a homely possession rather than an intellectual one.

entries.definition: emotions experienced when in a state of well-being
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain term of the set, naming the feeling of well-being itself without saying whether it is quiet or loud.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Slang that treats a premeditated killing as a job done, the coolness of the word doing the work *murder* does with weight.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and blunt, naming what *common sense* names with a grin at its own plainness.

entries.definition: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling of the same neutral faculty-name, adding nothing to *judgment* but a letter.

entries.definition: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The flat name for the ability to tell relations apart, stating the capacity without the admiration *sagacity* loads onto it.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal praise for judgment that comes out well, not merely for having the faculty at all.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Casts the reliance as bodily weight put on a support, carrying the hint that the one leaning could not stand unaided.
examples: We can lean on this man

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The faintest of the set, confidence as expectation turned toward a thing without the weight *lean* or *bank* place on it.
examples: Look to your friends for support

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Admiration that puts the object above the one feeling it; plainer and more informal than *venerate*.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the jumble something you are inside and lost in, with an intricacy *tangle* does not suggest.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same gay feeling with an outward, jolly noise on it that *gaiety* need not have.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Homely and affectionate where *good sense* is flatly commendatory, though the soundness praised is the same.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: On this sense it asks only for sadness, short of the weight *grieve* insists on.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flat, full-weight name for the act, leaving the premeditation showing where *dispatch* and *remove* tidy it out of sight.

entries.definition: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain word for what defeats understanding outright, and the one that can carry wonder alongside the bafflement rather than only frustration.
examples: how it got out is a mystery

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: One cold slang syllable, the deliberate act shrunk to a word too small to hold it.

entries.definition: trouble or confusion resulting from complexity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names both the trouble and the confusion together, and locates the cause in complexity rather than in the person confused.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Shares the suffering from slightly above it, so the warmth carries a downward tilt that *sympathize with* has not.

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Even and unruffled, the absence of emotion sounding closer to a settled flatness than to any achievement.

entries.definition: great coolness and composure under strain
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds balance and bearing to the coolness, praising how the strain is carried as much as the nerve behind it.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and jaunty, its air of finishing a task neatly is exactly what makes it callous here.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Carries the treasuring force of *prize* exactly, under a different spelling.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The regard of someone who would not part with it; more possessive than *value*.
examples: We prize his creativity

entries.definition: state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavorable options
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Softer than *dilemma*, dwelling on the wavering state of the person stuck rather than on how bad the options are.

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest of these: a temperament with no emotional weather in it, and none of the loftiness of *serenity*.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Informal, stating the faith as a settled count, plainer than *swear* and less deliberate than *calculate*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The peak of the set, happiness raised to great intensity rather than left at an even glow.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Steady and unemphatic: confidence as a standing arrangement rather than the wager *bet* makes of it.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Trust placed with assurance, active and chosen where *depend on* keeps the note of need.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal beside *rely on*, the same confident placing of trust carried with a stiffer bearing.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The furthest euphemism in the set, rendering a premeditated killing as an act of tidying and hiding the intent inside the blandness.

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The freedom from stress sounds like an ease rested in, warmer than the unstirred flatness of *placidity*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest way of holding something high, without the warmth of *admire* or the hush of *revere*.
examples: I respect his judgement

entries.definition: regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The felt act of reverence, awe aimed at what is held sacred, far past *respect*.

entries.definition: regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Lifts the object past approval into the hallowed, met with awe rather than judged.

entries.definition: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same commendation built plainly off the adjective, heavier in the mouth than *sagacity* and less polished for it.

entries.definition: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Lofty praise - credits a penetrating grasp of how things stand in relation, where *judgment* only names the faculty.

entries.definition: great coolness and composure under strain
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and faintly glamorous — nerve praised as a chill that strain cannot reach, more theatrical than *composure*.

entries.definition: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion

entries.label: neutral

entries.label: positive

entries.label: positive

entries.label: positive

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion
